messages:
ana-finance: FYI customer SolarBright (acct SB-112) had three consecutive card declines during invoice auto-pay. Processor flagged 3DS failure and locked the card token.
ryan-support: Ticket #65712 opened with the customer. They say the card was charged elsewhere and bank put a temporary hold. They asked if we can retry later.
tom-payments: Logs show decline codes: F63 (3DS auth required), then R04 (card activity). Token state = locked_by_processor. We attempted one automatic retry but blocked by processor.
throttle-bot: Auto-retry disabled for this instrument due to repeated non-recoverable decline.
nana-finance: (typo) sorry.
nana-finance: Suggestion: offer a one-time temporary credit for service while customer sorts bank and accept wire or new card within 48h. Need approval from sales and legal for credit > $5k. Invoice amount is $6,240.
laura-sales: Customer is on an annual plan, high retention risk. I'm OK with up to $7k temporary credit if legal signs off. We'll get a PO or card authorization on file.
nina-legal: We'll need a signed addendum authorizing temporary credit and commitment to pay via alternate method. I can draft a short form and send to the customer. Also want to record the decision in the customer's contract notes.
tom-payments: Operationally: we can create a manual payment instrument and mark invoice as pending_manual_pay if sales provides payment method. If they wire, we'll mark PAID once funds clear.
nana-finance: Please don't mark invoice as paid until funds clear. Also create GL memo for potential credit to reverse if they ultimately pay.
accounting-bot: Created internal memo GL-MEMO-2026-78 referencing SB-112, amount 6240, status tentative_credit.
ryan-support: Draft to customer: "We saw your bank placed a temporary hold and the card was locked for 3DS. To avoid interruption we can apply a one-time temporary credit of $6,240 for 48 hours while you provide a replacement payment method or complete a wire. Please reply to accept and sign the short authorization we will send."
laura-sales: Sending that now. I'll also ask for a screenshot from their bank and a contact at their card issuing bank.
tom-payments: Note: if they accept, I will provisionally apply a temporary credit code TC-SB-6240 that reduces invoice balance but keeps ledger entry for reconciliation.
nina-legal: Draft addendum sent to customer via DocuSign. Requires signature before we apply credit.
ryan-support: Customer signed addendum at 1798765560. They also said they initiated a same-day card update in their billing portal.
tom-payments: Received signed addendum. Applying temporary credit now and unlocking service. Code TC-SB-6240 applied.
accounting-bot: Invoice INV-2026-618 set to status: temp_credit_applied. Memo GL-MEMO-2026-78 updated.
nana-finance: Please schedule ACH/wire follow-up and set a 48h expiry on the temp credit. If payment not received, we'll reverse the credit and suspend services.
throttle-bot: 48h timer set for temp-credit-expiry job id tmp-2026-48h-1798765432.
laura-sales: Customer updated card and we authorized a $1 test charge successfully at 1798765610.
tom-payments: Captured full payment at 1798765628. Marking invoice PAID and reversing temp credit.
accounting-bot: Invoice marked PAID. GL entries: credit reversed, payment posted. Reference PAY-2026-881.
nana-finance: Thanks everyone. Filing postmortem on FIN-3602 to discuss adding clearer messaging on 3DS failures in the billing portal.
ryan-support: Closing ticket #65712. Customer confirmed no disruption and said thanks. :thumbsup:
